macro_bullets: Jensen Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO has ignited a broad semiconductor and AI-infrastructure rally heading into the open.
The Trump administration is set to unveil new tariffs following a probe into excess factory capacity, with warnings of steep chip levies.
Microsoft declared an internal 'Code Red' after a historic outage, raising reliability questions across cloud infrastructure.
Gold is behaving unusually and energy prices are soft, pressuring oil majors and defensive sectors.
Geopolitical risk is elevated as Houthis struck Riyadh's tallest tower and a reported cyber breach hit the CIA and ODNI.
internals_narrative: Risk-on rotation into tech dominates, with Robotics & Hardware (+15.6%) and Semiconductors (+13.8%) leading and names like NVDA (+31.5%), IREN (+23.9%) and MU (+19.0%) topping gainers. Defensives lag, as Energy (-0.8%) and Consumer Staples (-0.5%) slip and ELV (-3.8%), COP (-2.9%) and STZ (-2.9%) pace decliners.

ticker_notes.NVDA: Nvidia gave back $240 billion in market value even as a Wall Street upgrade signaled 29% upside.
ticker_notes.IREN: Dell is seeking up to 45% more on signed AI deals, posing a problem for IREN.
ticker_notes.MU: Bank of America warned Micron investors that 'semis cuts have started' as the stock hit a $700 ceiling and caught a downgrade.
ticker_notes.DRAM: Memory/semis ETFs like SOXX and DRAM are down 35.6%–51.9% from their highs amid the Nasdaq correction.
ticker_notes.MRVL: Marvell is rallying alongside Nvidia-fueled AI chip optimism.
ticker_notes.OUST: Electronic equipment and component shares are trading higher on renewed AI-infrastructure confidence after Huang's reinstatement.
ticker_notes.INTC: Trump's warning of '200% on chips' is pushing TSMC toward a $22.6 billion Texas plant, reshaping the US chip landscape.
ticker_notes.ELV: Medicare's proposed $107 billion in bonus cuts is a fresh risk for managed-care insurers.
ticker_notes.COP: ConocoPhillips announced a $4.425 billion asset sale aimed at boosting shareholder returns.
ticker_notes.STZ: Constellation Brands is under scrutiny as a long-term dividend hold versus Kimberly-Clark.
ticker_notes.SNDK: Investors are weighing Micron versus Sandisk as the better AI memory buy amid the storage selloff.
ticker_notes.AMT: American Tower proposed a settlement of its DISH/EchoStar litigation involving a $525 million cash payment.
ticker_notes.MPC: Refiners are heading into earnings cheap and profitable but under pressure.
ticker_notes.OXY: Occidental, down 17.8% in four weeks, is being flagged as ripe for a turnaround.
ticker_notes.CHTR: Fresh analyst estimates and ratings are in focus for Charter Communications.
ticker_notes.AZO: Analysts are weighing what could lift AutoZone stock after a losing year.
ticker_notes.AIG: FT's Gillian Tett sees 'uncanny micro-level parallels' between Nvidia and AIG, a warning sign.
ticker_notes.BA: Mizuho's $225 target argues Boeing's selloff went too far, and Cramer's trust bought more.
ticker_notes.APD: Air Products is seen as a better business that still needs to deliver.
ticker_notes.AEP: Utilities are in focus as AI drives electricity demand higher.
